installSummary: Dependency, documentation and release preparation can edit assigned local files; governance and merge review are read-only.
guidance: Project Management owns these delivery and governance agents. Assign the current skill, exact candidate or accepted plan, file ownership and validation. The parent owns policy decisions, GitHub writes, merges and releases.

roles.name: pm_dependency_maintainer
roles.routing: Dependency maintenance under delivery-lifecycle; scope, compatibility decisions and publication stay with the parent.

roles.name: pm_documentation_steward
roles.routing: Project-governance documentation edits; taxonomy and policy decisions return to the parent.

roles.name: pm_governance_auditor
roles.routing: Read-only governance, backlog and relationship audit; proposed plans and writes belong to the parent.

roles.name: pm_merge_reviewer
roles.routing: Read-only exact-candidate merge readiness under delivery-lifecycle; the parent performs authorized merges.

roles.name: pm_release_preparer
roles.routing: Bounded release preparation and evidence under publish-change; tags, releases and distribution remain parent decisions.
